Disappointing, shame
Jul 2024 • Family
We had dinner in this restaurant yesterday with family (2 adults and 2 children) yesterday. We ordered several dishes including Pekinese duck. not being able to finish everything, we asked to take away the remaining dishes (a full plate of noodles, 2 pieces of pigeons, 1 full plate of fried duck bones, a full plate of vegetables). Thu ngân bất lịch sự
Aug 2023 • Family
Nhà mình ăn ở Ái huê 1 gần 20 năm, nay mình ăn trưa ở Ái huê 2, lúc xem bill thanh toán mình check lại cho kĩ, và mình & mẹ chỉ đang thảo luận về gst /service charge ở đây với thái độ hết sức bình thường thì chị quản lý tên Candy (đồng phục đen) thu tiền cầm bill đi rồi nói chen vào thuế 10% vat phục vụ này kia giảm lại 2% còn 8% gì đó mình ko nghe rõ. Thái độ cực kì ko lịch sự và ko tôn trọng khách, sắc mặt nghênh ngang. Nhà hàng nên xem lại quản lý của mình, bất lịch sự hết sức.

This restaurant serves delicious food but customer service is so TERRIBLE and DISAPPOINTING! We are not the first time customer, we have been their regular guests for almost 20years at their first branch! Although it was not the first time at this second branch, we had lunch and was discussing about the VAT/service charge here before settling payment. We were happy making payment but the staff named Candy (in black uniform) collected payment and walked away raising her voice towards us saying there is a deduction of 2% VAT among the 10% VAT originally (that’s how their system works). Sorry to say this but she is damn rude and unprofessional towards guests. There are better restaurants with higher quality out there but my family has patronized this restaurant for such a long time. Didnt expect this to happen as our previous dine-outs here were pleasant enough.

Better than your average Cantonese restaurant in Saigon
Jan 2020
I have been to both Ai Hue I and II. I would rate the food at Ai Hue being very good and reasonably authentic Cantonese food - certainly on par with the same level restaurants in HK. The service staff are friendly and willing to help but perhaps lacking in confidence in dealing with western guests. In Saigon, it is going to get as good as it is going to get. The locals rate it highly and while it may not have the sophistication that western clients are looking for, it is very good.

Hair found in beef noodle dish
Jun 2019 • Family
21 June 2019.
After numerous visits to this restaurant, this evenings meal was nothing short of disgusting.
Upon serving the beef noodle dish, I found a very long hair in the noodles. I had it sent back to the kitchen to be redone. After 30 minutes it came back to my table COLD. It was never redone and they had the audacity to try serve it to me. I had no choice to cancel the dish and this very bad experience needs to be addressed. The service was slow and the kitchen staff obviously don’t care about food hygiene. As a result of this experience, I will never eat at this restaurant again, nor will I recommend it to anyone. 
I would like the management to provide an explanation to me.
Not a happy customer.

5 Star Restaurant, and more... - New York Standards
Dec 2015 • Friends
At first appearance, it looks more like a casino or hotel than a restaurant. The first time I was brought to the restaurant, I asked where the restaurant was even though we were standing right in front of it. It is beautiful on the outside and even more so on the inside. It is a 7 story restaurant that has a large dining area on the ground floor and some floors appropriate for weddings and large group parties. On the upper floors, there are absolutely gorgeous private dining rooms for small groups, with private servers to meet your every need.
The menu is extensive and excellent. The wine menu is just as good for those with discerning tastes. If you want an excellent eating experience in an upscale environment, this restaurant (there are actually 2 of them - I am referring to Ai Hue II), is not to be missed.
